title: Savings Guarantee and Measurement Terms Annex — Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Savings Guarantee and Measurement Terms Annex

Annex fixing, for each tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, the guarantee figures and the measurement and verification settings that attach to the tier.

## Guarantee figures

| Tier | Guaranteed savings commitment carried | Guaranteed reduction against the baseline for the year (percent) | Ceiling on what the company pays against the guarantee in one subscription year (USD) | Portion of a verified shortfall the company pays the owner (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | yes | 8 | 45000 | 75 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | yes | 14 | 180000 | 100 |


## Measurement settings

| Tier | Months of data forming the performance baseline (calendar months) | Baseline and reported use weather normalised | Measurement and verification option | Measured savings trued up against the guarantee | Baseline reset when a retrofit changes the building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 12 | no | none | none | no |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 12 | no | none | none | no |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 12 | yes | Option-C | annual | yes |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 12 | yes | Option-C | semiannual | yes |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 24 | yes | Option-B | annual | yes |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 24 | yes | Option-B | quarterly | yes |


## Clauses

1. A guarantee stands only at the Measurement & Verification Program and the Managed Energy Performance Program. At the four lower tiers the guaranteed reduction, the ceiling and the paid portion are all 0.
2. The guaranteed reduction is a percentage of the baseline for the subscription year: 8 percent at the Measurement & Verification Program, 14 percent at the Managed Energy Performance Program.
3. The ceiling is the most the company pays against the guarantee in one subscription year: USD 45000 and USD 180000 respectively.
4. The paid portion is the share of a verified shortfall the company pays: 75 percent and 100 percent respectively.
5. The baseline period is 12 calendar months at the four lower tiers and 24 calendar months at the two guarantee tiers.
6. Weather normalisation begins at the Energy Analytics Subscription; the measurement and verification option is Option C at the Energy Analytics Subscription and the Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription and Option B at the two guarantee tiers.
7. True-up frequency: none at the two lower tiers, annual at the Energy Analytics Subscription and the Measurement & Verification Program, semiannual at the Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription and quarterly at the Managed Energy Performance Program.
8. Baseline reset on retrofit applies from the Energy Analytics Subscription upward.
